method: Eleven pinned files whole text read, identities independently checked. Static Kotlin/Gradle source review only, not Android/JVM execution. README linked images remain pending visual review.
findings: LocalTrashManager.moveToTrash reads sourceFile.length/isDirectory/getFolderSize only after successful rename or copy+delete. Under ordinary moved-away source path, metadata records size0 and directoryfalse; source-order defect, not yet reproduced Android runtime. Destination type is used on restore so storedfalse does not itself prove failed restoration.

saveTrashItems catches all exceptions and returnsUnit; move/restore/permanentdelete may returntrue despite failed metadata update. Filewrites are direct overwrite, no atomic temp+rename. getTrashItems parse/read error returns empty, permitting later update to overwrite formerly recoverable inventory.
Restore has no destination-conflict rejection; fallback copyTo/copyRecursively overwrite=true can replace existing destination. Rename behavior platformdependent. No files restored/deleted in review.
emptyTrash unconditionally saves empty metadata even when deleteRecursivelyfalse. Partial deletion failure can orphan remainingtrash entries from inventory. No failure injection performed.

Crossvolume directory copy then recursive delete can partially remove source and returnfalse without adding inventory; partialcopy destination may remain. Static nontransactional failure paths, no actual user mutation.

Room pinnedfile identity primarykey is path; insertREPLACE overwrites samepath metadata; not content identity or snapshot. Database version2 fallbackToDestructiveMigration permits schema migration losing pinned data; no migration/persistence tests run.
Room singleton checks INSTANCE outside synchronized but does not recheck inside; concurrent firstcall can build multiple instances. Static concurrency hypothesis, not multithread reproduced.

Android build minSdk24 contradicts README legacyAPI21-28 support range at21-23; compile36 target35 match README. Explicit screenshot/test dependencies exist but assembleRelease task is not an explicit unit/instrumentation invocation.

Release signing fallback points rootdebug.keystore when no productionkey; preview uses standard debug config then. CI secretabsence does not prove releaseAPK success because fallbackfile availability not yet qualified. No keys read.
Proguard keeps broad MLKit/OkHttp/coroutines classes; buildresource shrink/minify enabled. No release behavior or size/throughput comparison.

Android README calls filetransfer chunked/local/pinned/encrypted; sync implementation still pending, no qualification from documentation alone. Gradle wrapper/property files declare dependencies/runtime settings, not behavioral proof.
